entries.title: Isaiah 57:1
segments: ¶The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth [it] to heart: and merciful men [are] taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil [to come]. {merciful...: Heb. men of kindness, or, godliness} {from...: or, from that which is evil}

entries.title: Isaiah 57:2

entries.title: Isaiah 57:3
segments: ¶But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:4
segments: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, [and] draw out the tongue? [are] ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

words.text: yourselves? against whom make ye a wide

entries.title: Isaiah 57:5
segments: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks? {with...: or, among the oaks}

entries.title: Isaiah 57:6
segments: Among the smooth [stones] of the stream [is] thy portion; they, they [are] thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

words.text: : even to them hast thou poured

entries.title: Isaiah 57:7
segments: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:8
segments: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered [thyself to another] than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee [a covenant] with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest [it]. {made...: or, hewed it for thyself larger than theirs} {where...: or, thou providedst room}

thee [a covenant] with them; thou lovedst
[it]. {made...: or, hewed it for thyself larger than theirs} {where...: or, thou providedst room}

entries.title: Isaiah 57:9
segments: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase [thyself even] unto hell. {thou...: or, thou respectedst}

entries.title: Isaiah 57:10
segments: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; [yet] saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved. {life: or, living}

words.text: thou not, There is no hope

entries.title: Isaiah 57:11
segments: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid [it] to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

words.text: And of whom hast thou been afraid
? have not I held my peace

entries.title: Isaiah 57:12
segments: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:13
segments: ¶When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take [them]: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

words.text: [them]: but he that putteth his trust

entries.title: Isaiah 57:14
segments: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:15
segments: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name [is] Holy; I dwell in the high and holy [place], with him also [that is] of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

words.text: [place], with him also [that is] of a contrite

entries.title: Isaiah 57:16
segments: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls [which] I have made.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:17
segments: ¶For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart. {frowardly: Heb. turning away}

entries.title: Isaiah 57:18
segments: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

words.text: unto him and to his mourners

entries.title: Isaiah 57:19
segments: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to [him that is] far off, and to [him that is] near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:20
segments: But the wicked [are] like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:21
segments: [There is] no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
